definitions.explanation: The original location or country where a plant, animal, or product comes from.

examples.japanese: トマトは{南米|なんべい}{原産|げんさん}の{野菜|やさい}です。
examples.english: Tomatoes are vegetables native to South America.

examples.japanese: {原産地|げんさんち}を{確認|かくにん}してから{買|か}います。
examples.english: I check the place of origin before buying.

examples.japanese: この{品種|ひんしゅ}は{日本|にほん}{原産|げんさん}です。
examples.english: This variety is native to Japan.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{原産|げんさん}{地|ち} (place of origin)
・{原産|げんさん}{国|こく} (country of origin)
・〜{原産|げんさん} (native to ~)

USAGE NOTE:
Often seen on food labels indicating where ingredients or products come from. {原産地|げんさんち}{表示|ひょうじ} (origin labeling) is required by law for many food products in Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{産地|さんち} - producing area (where something is currently produced)
・{出身|しゅっしん} - origin (used for people)

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
